findings: All 22 text files and 48 original images accounted for; fixtures are 16 source scenes in three encoding/size variants, all single-frame and no alpha channel under Pillow.
Two black/gold cabinet scenes are visually similar but distinct objects with different panels; useful false-positive control rather than duplicate ground truth.
64-bit DCT recipe excludes zero-frequency row and column, uses PointFilter grayscale quantization, transposed frequency ordering and below-median bits; differs from 63-AC pHash.
Independent arithmetic controls validate 8x8 DCT to <8e-12 absolute error, all 64 bit positions and all 120 unordered stored golden-hash distances. No image hash recomputation claim.
Prior source audit identifies package license omission (glob LICENSE vs LICENSE.txt) and workflow matrix mismatch; root MIT text read, no source code adopted.
limits: Ruby2.6 below gem declared>=2.7 and RMagick absent: original RSpec/image pipeline not executed; completion means full source/assets review, not runtime qualification.
No speed, broad accuracy, animation/HDR/rotation/crop or cross-decoder equivalence claim.
